# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux desktop environment (indicated by "Activities" in top-left corner)
- **Application Title Bar**: "Thunderbird Mail" displayed on the left side of the top bar
- **Current Date and Time**: "Oct 22 21:43" displayed in the center of the top bar
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the top bar, including network, sound, and power icons
- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird" displayed in the active email composition window
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons located on the top-right corner of the composition window

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock

- **Left Dock Panel**: Vertical application launcher with icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Firefox
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash
- **Bottom Dock**: Contains a grid icon for application launcher and a "Done" button at the bottom-left corner

## Thunderbird Main Window

- **Active Tab**: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird" displayed in the tab
- **Search Bar**: Located at the top of the main window, with a magnifying glass icon
- **Menu Bar**: "Account Settings" button located on the top-right corner
- **Feature Buttons**: "Message filters" and "End-to-end Encryption" links visible in the main content area
- **Navigation Buttons**: "Filelink", "Feeds", and "Newsgroups" buttons located in the main content area
- **Footer Text**: "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation." with a hyperlink to "make a donation"
- **Logo**: A faint Thunderbird logo (stylized bird) visible in the bottom-right corner

## Email Composition Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **Menu Bar**: "File", "Edit", "View", "Insert", "Format", "Options", "Tools", "Help"
- **Toolbar**: Contains "Send", "Encrypt", "Spelling", "Save", "Contacts", and "Attach" buttons
- **From Field**: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>" with a dropdown for account selection
- **To Field**: "alexi.riviero@gmail.com" entered in the recipient field
- **Cc and Bcc Fields**: "Cc" and "Bcc" fields visible with a right-pointing arrow button
- **Subject Field**: Empty field for entering the email subject
- **Formatting Toolbar**: Contains options for paragraph style, variable width, font color, font size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, list styles, and emoticons
- **Email Body**: Large white text area with a blinking cursor indicating the current position for typing
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons located on the top-right corner of the composition window

## Additional Interface Elements

- **Sidebar Icons**: Located on the left side of the main window, including icons for mail, calendar, tasks, and chat
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the main window, displaying "Done" on the left side
- **Window Decorations**: Standard Linux window decorations with shadows and rounded corners
- **Application Icons**: Located in the top-left corner of the Thunderbird window, including a mail icon and a settings icon
